notes.title: DEMO Update！
notes.content:
Hello Guys!

Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share that Ana's Farm is entering its final development stage! 🎉

We’ve also rolled out several updates to the public DEMO, including:

- New Camera Controls: Use WASD keys or right mouse button drag for easier navigation.
- Resizable Window Support.
- Visual Updates & Optimizations: Improved UI, art assets, and item effects.
- Enhanced Tutorials & Guidance: Clear exploration directions and task-related tutorials.
- New Interactive Objects: Discover floating elemental creatures and shiny rocks from trees.
- Croplyn’s Story System: Crop spirits now trigger unique story dialogues based on game progress!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221098/cf88d730f96f71d96edd523bd6a71dd275c2ff4f.png[/img]

We’d love for you to try out this updated DEMO! If you have any feedback or ideas, feel free to drop a comment here or reach out on social media. We’ll keep working hard to make the game even better—thank you so much for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221098/043709e82c5e73ba66cd9dd98a96c7394d47f857.png[/img]

Grey Matters?

notes.title: Thank You for playing during the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has played or followed Ana's Farm Demo!

Our biggest goal is to bring you all a fun and enjoyable experience, and we're thrilled to have received so much feedback during this time! Your input has been incredibly encouraging, and we’re carefully taking in every precious suggestion to keep improving the game.

Some of the areas we’re focusing on include: 
[list]
 [*] Map toggle experience, interaction with the mission UI, item obtaining and using experiences 
 [*] Story presentation, character interactions, character development.
 [*] BGM and sound effects adjustment!
 [/list]

As our very first game on Steam, Ana's Farm still has a lot to be polished and completed. We're working hard to make it an even better game before its release.
Once again, thank you to everyone who has noticed Ana's Farm. We appreciate your love!
